definition: to put your arms around someone tightly
description: A young man in a white T-shirt and jeans runs across a wide mountain meadow of tall golden grass and small wildflowers at sunset. A young woman with long brown hair, also in a white top and jeans, runs into his arms from the other side. They put their arms around each other tightly and turn round together, her hair flying out in the wind, then stand still, holding each other close. The low sun shines behind them over forested hills and distant mountains.
transcript: I make many mistakes in life, but they bring me to you.

en.question: What are the man and woman doing?

de.question: Was machen der Mann und die Frau?

es.answer: Se están abrazando en la hierba.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo el hombre y la mujer?
